name: How do walk-in showers prevent water from leaking onto the bathroom floor?

mainEntity.name: How do walk-in showers prevent water from leaking onto the bathroom floor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Water containment in walk-in showers relies on a properly sloped shower pan, strategically placed showerheads, and moisture-resistant splash barriers. In curbless designs, the floor must slope evenly toward a central or linear drain to prevent standing water. Showerheads and body sprays must be oriented away from open entries to prevent water from splashing onto the main bathroom floor. High-performance bathroom exhaust fans are also critical to control humidity and prevent moisture accumulation on nearby drywall and cabinetry.
acceptedAnswer.description: Proper water containment requires correct floor slope toward the drain, strategic showerhead placement, and splash barriers or targeted glass panels.
